desc: Opaque attic access hatch seen from the attic side with a thick rigid foam insulation panel, foil-taped perimeter, weatherstrip gasket, raised insulation dam, and plywood service walkway in a Florida truss attic.
reuse_notes: Use for attic-access hatches, thermal-boundary details, hatch weatherstripping, attic insulation, and safe service-access articles. It depicts a generic insulated hatch assembly, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a hatch upgrade alone resolves a home's comfort or moisture issues.
